mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (N_ID, N_TITLE, N_CONTENT, N_DATE, N_COUNT, N_CHK) VALUES (#{n_id}, #{n_title}, #{n_content}, #{n_date}, 0, #{n_chk})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM notice WHERE 1=1 AND N_DEL = 'N' AND N_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') AND N_CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') ORDER BY n_chk DESC , n_seq desc limit #{listcnt} offset #{start}
SELECT * FROM NOTICE WHERE N_SEQ= #{n_seq} AND N_DEL = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET N_COUNT = IFNULL(#{n_count}, 0)+1 WHERE n_seq = #{n_seq}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice WHERE 1=1 AND N_DEL = 'N' AND N_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') AND N_CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%')
